sentences.en: The compensation will be paid out as a lump sum.
sentences.zh: 这笔赔偿将以一次性付款的方式发放。

sentences.en: The victims are entitled to compensation for their injuries.
sentences.zh: 受害者有权因受伤获得赔偿。

sentences.en: This job is tough, though it has other compensations.
sentences.zh: 这份工作虽然辛苦，但也有一些补偿之处。
